newsitem.title: BELGIUM: "Doctor" who preyed on women arrested in Belgium.
newsitem.headline: "Doctor" who preyed on women arrested in Belgium.

text.p: A Belgian man posing as a health inspector has been arrested after duping 30 pregnant women into letting him conduct gynaecological examinations and filming them, Belga news agency said on Sunday.

The unnamed 39-year old French speaker attracted clients by offering financial help with the birth and free sanitary towels. He then picked as his targets women who were poor and who lived alone in the north of the country, Belga said.

Arriving at the house of his victim with another man posing as a nurse, the bogus doctor first took their blood pressure and then told the women to undress for an ultrasound scan -- which was in fact a normal camera.
After that he carried out a gynaecological examination.
Police got onto his trail after one woman complained. He was arrested on Friday near Antwerp.
